title: Call: Rivermark Kits QA — Paper Receiving, Lots Without Shift Letter

callee.name: Kevin Oyelaran
callee.label: Traceability and Systems Lead, Pinecrest Fresh Cut

transcript.speaker: Delia (Rivermark QA)
transcript.text: Morning, this is Delia at Rivermark QA in Fresno, returning your hold notice. Is this traceability?

transcript.speaker: Delia (Rivermark QA)
transcript.text: Okay. So, we show two thousand six hundred cases of your chopped romaine received. That part's solid, it matches the bills of lading. Our receiving is still on paper clipboards, though. And the night crew wrote some of the lots as P-F-1, two-seven-eight, L-2. No shift letter. Just 'PF1-278-L2.'

transcript.speaker: Delia (Rivermark QA)
transcript.text: Honestly, I can't tell you which Caesar kit runs used which lot until our office manager gets in at 9:00. She keeps the production sheets that tie receiving to the kit runs. And I have to tell you, some kits from Friday's run already went out to our national retail accounts.

transcript.speaker: Delia (Rivermark QA)
transcript.text: Right now I've got the romaine itself tagged in our cooler. The finished kits aren't on hold yet. So tell me. Do you want us to hold everything with romaine in it, or just the lots we can match?

transcript.speaker: Delia (Rivermark QA)
transcript.text: Okay. Send me that in writing so I can show my plant manager, and I'll get you what I can before nine.

voiceStyles.Delia (Rivermark QA): Woman in her 40s, practical and cooperative but rushed, a bit apologetic about the paperwork. Cooler fans and forklift beepers in the background.

instructorNote: This is a clue inject. It tests whether the team widens scope when lot boundaries are uncertain (PPHTRP 5): the Recall Coordinator should ask Rivermark to hold every kit that could contain the five lots, not only the lots it can match. Trace should log the 'PF1-278-L2' entries without a shift letter as gaps in the trace sheet's gap tab (PLCTR 5), keep the full lot-code format, and ask Rivermark for its downstream ship list, including Friday's shipments to retail.
